routes.listener: the product's internal address on this machine: OF_TEDER_INTERNAL (127.0.0.1:4700) or OF_TORAN_INTERNAL (127.0.0.1:4710)
routes.auth: Authorization: Bearer <OF_INTERNAL_TOKEN> (32 characters or more), from a loopback socket and not through Caddy (no X-Forwarded-For)
routes.notes: accounts sends it once a change to a workspace's access is committed (a payment recorded; also a subscription saved by hand, comp, a cancellation and its undo, a product turned on or off, the workspace disabled or enabled), to each product the workspace has, and never waits for it: 2 seconds, then a line in its log and nothing more. The product drops the answer it keeps from GET /internal/entitlement for that workspace, so its next page or check asks accounts afresh instead of up to 5 minutes later; the last answer stays kept underneath for the 24 hours accounts may be down. reason is for the product's log (paid, subscription, comp, cancelled, resumed, product, workspace); a product acts the same on every one, and on one it does not know. Idempotent: a workspace it never asked about answers 200 with cleared false. The checks come in this order: 503, 403, 401, 405, 400.

answers.case: cleared: the next page or check asks accounts afresh
nothing kept for that workspace (never asked about, or deleted)
no workspace id in the body (a positive integer)
no token, or the wrong one
not from this machine, or through Caddy
